sourceNote: Hand-maintained from https://claude.com/resources/courses. Verify before relying on entries marked status='unverified'.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Foundations
courses.summary: Plain-English foundations for working with Claude — what it is, what it can and can't do, and how to ask for what you want.
learningObjectives: Describe what an LLM is in non-technical terms
Recognize where Claude fits a task vs. where it doesn't
Write a clear, well-scoped prompt
Spot common failure modes (hallucination, drift, refusal)

courses.title: Claude with the Claude API
courses.summary: Developer onboarding to the Claude API — auth, requests, streaming, parameters.
learningObjectives: Authenticate and make a first API call
Use system prompts and message structure correctly
Stream responses
Tune temperature, max_tokens, and stop sequences

courses.title: Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial
courses.summary: Hands-on tutorial covering core prompt-engineering techniques with Claude.
learningObjectives: Apply role prompting and clear instructions
Use examples (few-shot) effectively
Structure complex prompts with XML tags
Chain prompts for multi-step problems

courses.title: Real-World Prompting
courses.summary: Apply prompting techniques to production-style problems: extraction, classification, summarization, drafting.
learningObjectives: Design prompts that survive messy real input
Reduce hallucination with grounding and citations
Iterate prompts using small evaluation sets
Decide when to use a system prompt vs. user content

courses.title: Prompt Evaluations
courses.summary: Build evaluation sets to measure prompt quality and catch regressions.
learningObjectives: Construct a small but useful eval set
Choose between exact-match, model-graded, and human grading
Track regressions across prompt iterations
Wire evals into a deployment workflow

courses.title: Tool Use with Claude
courses.summary: Give Claude tools (functions) it can call to take actions and fetch data.
learningObjectives: Define a tool schema Claude understands
Handle the request → tool_use → tool_result loop
Run multiple tools in parallel safely
Debug when Claude picks the wrong tool

courses.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
courses.summary: Connect Claude to external systems with MCP — the open protocol for tools, resources, and prompts.
learningObjectives: Explain how MCP clients and servers communicate
Build a simple MCP server
Expose tools, resources, and prompts
Use an MCP server from a Claude client

courses.title: Claude Code in Action
courses.summary: Use Claude Code as a coding agent in the terminal, IDE, and on the web.
learningObjectives: Run Claude Code on a real codebase
Use slash commands, hooks, and CLAUDE.md effectively
Set up MCP servers for project-specific tools
Review and commit AI-generated changes safely

courses.title: Building Agents with Claude
courses.summary: Design multi-step agents that plan, use tools, and recover from failure.
learningObjectives: Pick the right agent loop shape for your task
Manage context and memory across steps
Add guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
Evaluate agent reliability
